newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed this week on 98,800 head including 22,800 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Most feedlots sold this week's supplies.
Bids and asking prices not well established Friday, last sales Thursday, April 17 at 68.00.
Confirmed - none week ago - none year ago - 300
